slices.summary: After months of building work stress compounded by school transition planning leaves her sleeping badly and carrying anger home, Monica starts short-term counseling through the city's employee assistance program; she targets evening transitions, text cutoffs, and sleep tracking as concrete steps to keep home from feeling colonized by work conflict.
